Wa-hey!

with my straight-arm punch.

I’m a failure!

is good for calming nervous tension,
relieving aching muscles, solving
romantic problems, and attracting
money…

johto_2_24:50.message:
…Hnuurg… Huh?

I walked too far today looking for
Pokémon.

My feet hurt and I’m sleepy…

If I were a wild Pokémon, I’d be
easy to catch…

…Zzzz…

johto_2_24:7.message:

That’s surprising for one as young
as you.

johto_2_24:8.message:
If people put Pokémon in hot springs,
it might be seriously strange.

Why, it might be an electric bath, or
a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…

johto_2_24:9.message:
We draw as much hot water as we need,
and yet the hot springs never run dry.

Isn’t it magical?

These hot springs appear near active
volcanoes. Veins of water under the
ground are heated by magma to well up
as hot springs.

johto_2_24:10.message:
I have here an Egg.

I’d hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.
But that doesn’t seem to be enough…

I’ve heard it would be best if it were
kept together with Pokémon and
carried about.

You are a Trainer, yes?

So, what say you?
Will you take this Egg to hatch?

I bathe in the hot springs every day.

strong Gym Leader like Flannery.

gave it some Protein.

level up and become stronger.

stronger, you’ll be able to go

and the mountains!

he was way too strong.

How would I put it?

I just got the feeling that he
lives for Pokémon.

can raise the EVs in a given stat
is 255, and that a Pokémon can
only have a maximum of 510 EVs in
total.

Every Pokémon has a special ability
that it can use.

In all sorts of places, there are all
sorts of Pokémon and people.

all sorts of places.

Rustboro, my dad helped out.

the land of trees.

Roxanne, the Gym Leader, really

become a Gym Leader.

that’s easy to understand, but…

For my own Pokémon, I give them
perfectly suited nicknames!

It’s my expression of, uh…
originality, yes, that’s it!

Verdanturf all by his lonesome.

without using machines, he won’t
disturb Pokémon, and he’ll avoid
harming the natural environment.

I wonder if he made it through yet.

johto_2_60:22.message:
That Rusturf Tunnel there…

At first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.
But, we had to stop.

It turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild Pokémon in
the area.

So, we’ve got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.

johto_2_60:23.message:
To get to Verdanturf without using
this Tunnel, you’d have to cross the
sea to Dewford, sail on to Slateport,
then travel through Mauville.

johto_2_60:24.message:
My daughter’s boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.

He’s been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.

My daughter’s a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.

johto_2_60:25.message:
Thanks to you, I can see my
girlfriend every day.
Happy? You bet I am!

johto_2_60:26.message:
Wanda: Don’t worry about Wally.
He’ll be just fine.

I know my little cousin, and he has
Pokémon with him, too.

johto_2_60:27.message:
Uncle: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Wally’s next door.

But, boy, there’s something I have to
tell you.

This natural environment is doing
wonders for Wally’s health.

Maybe it’s not just the environment.
It could be Pokémon that are giving
the boy hope.

johto_2_60:28.message:
Wally: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I’m
not feeling down anymore.

Because I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my buddy, I’m going
to challenge Pokémon Gyms and become
a great Trainer.

Please watch me, {PLAYER}.
I’m going to be stronger than you.

When I do, I’m going to challenge you
to another battle.

johto_2_60:29.message:
In the Pokémon League, I think the
rules say that you have to battle
the Elite Four all in a row.

If you lose to any of them, you have
to begin your challenge again from
the first one.

johto_2_60:30.message:
Far away, deep in Ever Grande City,
is the Pokémon League.

The Trainers who gather there are
all frighteningly well skilled.

johto_2_60:31.message:
There’s a deep underwater trench
between Mossdeep and Sootopolis.

That’s what someone told me, anyway.

johto_2_60:32.message:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you’re so young! Good for you!

I’m sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!

Me? I’m a master of PokéBlocks.

If I get serious just a little, why,
I can concoct great PokéBlocks.

johto_2_60:33.message:
When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,
you bet I was shocked.

But, now, seeing them play together,
it makes me happy.

johto_2_60:34.message:
For two years, I was dating a
Team Magma grunt, the sweetest
girl around.

For two years, I have missed her,
the sweetest sorrow of my life.

johto_2_60:35.message:
The sea breeze tickles my heart.
It feels wonderful here!

johto_2_60:37.message:
I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac.

I know every single move that
Pokémon learn growing up.

I’m also a mushroom maniac.

Bring me two TinyMushrooms,
or one Big Mushroom.

If you do that for me, I’ll teach
a move to one Pokémon.

johto_2_60:38.message:
Uh…
Oh, yes, I’m the Move Deleter.

I can make Pokémon forget their
moves.

Would you like me to do that?

johto_2_60:39.message:
Pokémon are partners to people.
They aren’t our tools.

Unfortunately, there are some people
who fail to understand that…

johto_2_60:40.message:
You are really popular…

You’re strong, and you’re caring to
Pok. No one can knock you.

But, you know, I believe in Cynthia

Cynthia is definitely stronger!
I’m positive!

johto_2_60:41.message:
Wow, you really are strong.
Maybe even stronger than Leon.

But Leon needs me.

If I don’t cheer for Leon,
who will?

johto_2_60:42.message:
Even when things turned bleak,
your father never gave up.

This I know to be true.

You never give up even if you lose!
So keep on battling!

johto_2_60:43.message:
Winona really is cool, don’t
you think so?

Even if it’s just me, I’m going to
keep cheering my favorite Trainer.

johto_2_60:44.message:
Even if I’m the only one…

I’m never going to stop being
Diantha’s fan!

Because I’ve heard, Diantha
never loses!

johto_2_60:45.message:
Darn it… I’ve been telling people
that Iris is the best now…

But no one wants to listen…

johto_2_60:46.message:
Nobody understands the charm of
Brawly…

I don’t care!

Even if I’m the only one, I’m going
to keep cheering for Brawly!

johto_2_60:47.message:
I’m the Graphic Artist! Aren’t the
Pokémon here interesting?

johto_2_60:48.message:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using Pokémon as attractions?

Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute
Pokémon our inn’s mascot.

I wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?

johto_2_60:49.message:
This planet’s biggest mysteries are
at the bottom of the sea.

Somebody said that, but I don’t know…

johto_2_60:50.message:
The Silk Scarf raises the power of
Normal-type moves.

It’s a marvelous Scarf that will go
with almost all Pokémon!

johto_2_60:51.message:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% error margin is allowed.

Even if it’s 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be bad.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It’s a dream that never ends.

johto_2_60:52.message:
I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket launched safely!
That’s successful launch no. 1!

johto_2_60:53.message:
My big brother’s the Fossil Maniac…
He’s a nice guy who loves Fossils…

He loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…

You can have this, so you can Dig
holes just like my big brother…

johto_2_60:54.message:
There’s a lot to be said for living on
a small island like this in harmony
with Pokémon and the family.

johto_2_60:55.message:
Prof. Cozmo: Oh…
I never should have let myself be
conned into telling Team Magma where
you can find Meteorites…

That Meteorite from Meteor Falls…
It’s never going to be mine now…

johto_2_60:56.message:
Prof. Cozmo went off to Meteor Falls
on Route 114 with some people from
Team Magma.

johto_2_60:57.message:
Lanette: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

I’m sorry everything is so cluttered…
When I get engrossed in research,
things end up this way…

This is embarrassing… Please keep
this a secret in exchange for this.

johto_2_60:58.message:
I left the major port of Slateport
City when I married my husband here.

Life goes by slowly on this little
island. But being surrounded by the
beautiful sea--that’s happiness, too.

johto_2_60:59.message:
Oh, dear, dear.
Aren’t your Pokémon exhausted?

If you’d like, rest up here.
That’s a fine idea! You must do that.

johto_2_60:60.message:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit Dewford?

Did you maybe come here because you
heard about Brawly?

He’s so cool…
Everyone idolizes him.

johto_2_60:61.message:
What’s in vogue? Why, it has to be
Terastals!

I can’t imagine what life would be like
without Terastals!

johto_2_60:62.message:
Let me let you in on a secret.
There are rumored sightings of a
very special Milotic somewhere
near the island.

No one’s been able to catch it!

johto_2_60:63.message:
I’m studying up on the hip and trendy
Mega now.

Is it true that there’s a deep link
between Humans and Pokémon?

johto_2_60:64.message:
This whole business about
Evolution.
Isn’t there a TV show on it?

johto_2_60:66.message:
This area is covered in volcanic ash,
huff-puff!

I’m specially gifted, huff-puff.

I make glass out of volcanic ash
and make items, huff-puff.

Go collect ashes! huff-puff.

johto_2_60:67.message:
It’s fun to blow a glass flute while
my boss is talking.

Huff-huff! Puff-puff!

johto_2_60:68.message:
You’re…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}, right?

Thank you for playing with Wally a
little while ago.

He’s been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.

We’ve sent him to stay with my relatives
in Verdanturf Town for a while.

The air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.

What’s that? Where’s Wally?
He’s already left, our Wally.

I wonder where he could have
gotten by now?

johto_2_60:69.message:
Let me see your Pokémon.
I’ll check to see how much it likes you.

Oh.
Your Pokémon…

johto_2_60:70.message:
I’m the Pokémon Move Maniac.

I know every single move that
Pokémon learn growing up.

I’m also a mushroom maniac.

Bring me two TinyMushrooms,
or one Big Mushroom.

If you do that for me, I’ll teach
a move to one Pokémon.

johto_2_60:71.message:
I heard about a cave called the
Cave Of Wishes.

People rumor that the spirits of
Pokémon are revived there. Could
something like that really happen?

johto_2_60:72.message:
My wife’s warming an Egg in the hot
springs. This is what she told me.

She left two Pokémon with the Day Care.
And they discovered that Egg!

johto_2_60:73.message:
Herbal medicine works impressively well.
But your Pokémon will dislike you for it.
It must be horribly bitter!

johto_2_60:74.message:
Max Revives are impossible to
buy-you’re better off feeding
your Pokémon those yuc… err…
yummy Revival Herbs!

johto_2_60:75.message:
Hello, dear.

I sell inexpensive herbal medicine.

They’re good, but a trifle bitter.
Your Pokémon may not like them.

Hehehehe...

The Path will be revealed only to
Dragon Masters.

johto_2_61:16.message:
The Path will be revealed only to

This Badge is yours.

Go on, check out my PC.

johto_2_62:2.message:

johto_2_63:1.message:
There are odd patterns drawn on the
walls of the Ruins.

They must be the keys for unraveling
the mystery of the Ruins.

johto_2_63:2.message:
The Ruins are about 1500 years
old…

But it’s not known why they were
built--or by whom.

johto_2_63:5.message:
There’s an explicative note:

Up-Grade: Used to evolve Porygon.
Dubious Disc: Evolve Porygon 2.

johto_2_64:1.message:
In the past, Pokémon used to light
the sea around Olivine at night.

The Lighthouse was made in honor of
those Pokémon.

johto_2_64:2.message:
People train at this Lighthouse.

It’s not easy to climb because of
all the trainers.

johto_2_64:18.message:
Jasmine: …This Pokémon always
kept the sea lit at night.

But it suddenly got sick… It’s
gasping for air…

…I understand that there is a
wonderful Pharmacy in Cianwood…

But that’s across the sea…
And I can’t leave Amphy unattended…

…May I ask you to get some medicine
for me? Please?

johto_2_64:19.message:
Amphy: …
…Pa… paloo…

Its breathing is terribly labored…

johto_2_64:20.message:
I have spent my whole life
training these arms of iron to
reel in Gyarados that can crush
houses, not these worthless
splashing rejects!

johto_2_64:22.message:
Jasmine: …This Pokémon always
kept the sea lit at night.

…But it suddenly got sick…
It’s gasping for air…

…I understand that there is a
wonderful PHARMACY in Cianwood…

But that’s across the sea…
And I can’t leave AMPHY unattended.

……May I ask you to get some
medicine for me?
Please?

johto_2_64:23.message:
Ahoy, there!
Where do you want to sail?

johto_2_64:24.message:
I wanted to go with Capt. Stern on
the ocean floor exploration.

But the sub’s too small for me.

If I squeezed in, there wouldn’t be
any room for the Captain…

johto_2_64:25.message:
Ahoy, there!
Where do you want to sail?

johto_2_64:26.message:
The ferry S.S. Tidal is finally in
operation.

The folks at the Shipyard in
Slateport must’ve worked extra hard.

Well, it’s my turn to get busy now!

johto_2_64:27.message:
I might not look like it, but I’m
a best-selling author who writes
about the madcap, haunting
misadventures of trainers and
their Pokémon.

johto_2_65:1.message:
Sootopolis sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.

If you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible. So,
all you see is the sky in a circle.

But that’s what makes the sky above
Sootopolis the most beautiful.

johto_2_65:2.message:
The weather was clear this morning,
but…

All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed
up, rain started falling in sheets,
and there was thunder and lightning.

The weather just went completely
wild!

Is all of this because of those
Pokémon?

johto_2_65:3.message:
These giant Pokémon suddenly
appeared in the middle of the city!

And, I’ve never seen them before!

Why are they smashing into each
other like that?

Why can’t they be friends, those
Pokémon?

johto_2_65:4.message:
I… I’ve never been out of this city.

I wonder what the world is like on
the other side of this round sky?

johto_2_65:5.message:
Hm!

You’ve come all the way to
Sootopolis?

You’re no ordinary tourist.

But I suppose that doesn’t make you
an extraordinary tourist, either.

johto_2_65:6.message:
A big Pokémon is fighting with
another big Pokémon!

Please, someone make them stop!

johto_2_65:7.message:
Have you taken the Pokémon Gym
challenge?

Ah! No, wait, don’t tell me…

johto_2_65:8.message:
You know, it’s so hard being an
artist like Juan. I do wonder
though.

But why he puts his loving fans in
an icy basement where trainers fall
into?

johto_2_67:9.message:
Hey…
It sure is dark in here…

Say, how about I give you
something…

It’s just a Pokémon…

johto_2_68:1.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_2_68:2.message:
Do you know about Apricorns?

Crack one open, hollow it out and
fit it with a special device.

Then you can catch Pokémon with it.

Before PokéBalls were invented,
everyone used Apricorns.

johto_2_68:3.message:
Heheh! The experiment worked like a
charm.

Magikarp are just worthless, but
Gyarados are big moneymakers.

johto_2_68:5.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_2_68:6.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_2_69:2.message:
Sob, sob, sob. I lost my PokéBlock
in the Union Cave!
I can’t find it anywhere.

Can you go and look for it please?
I really want it back.

Sob, sob, sob.

johto_2_69:5.message:
Union Cave…
Someone told me there is a strong
water Pokémon in there…

johto_2_69:7.message:
I found a good Pokémon in a tree.

I’m going to raise it to take on
Bugsy.

johto_2_69:8.message:
Zinnia: This kid won’t let anyone into
Azalea until he gets his PokéBlock
Case back.

Please do something {PLAYER}!

johto_2_7:1.message:
Hello…

I am the admin of this Tower…

How the sky soars above this
rooftop…

The caress of the winds up here…

It’s all so perfect…

The way you battled…
It, too, was perfection…

johto_2_70:3.message:
I… I’m Cozmo…
I’m a Professor…

Team Magma asked me to guide them
to Meteor Falls…

But they tricked me.
They even took my Meteorite away…

And then another similar bunch,
Team Aqua showed up.

After that…
I don’t understand any of it.

But that Team Magma…

What are they going to do with that
Meteorite at Mt. Chimney?

johto_2_71:23.message:
I love Grass-type Pokémon!

Do you have any Grass-type Pokémon?

johto_2_72:11.message:
See the pillar shaking?

People are training upstairs.

johto_2_72:12.message:
A Bellsprout over 100 feet tall…
People say that it became the
center pillar here.

johto_2_72:14.message:
Sprout Tower was built long ago
as a place for Pokémon training.

johto_2_72:15.message:
Only if you reach the top will you
obtain an HM.

johto_2_74:3.message:
I’m waiting for Pokémon that
appear only at night.

johto_2_74:15.message:
Different kinds of Pokémon appear
past here.

If you want to catch them all, you
have to look everywhere.

johto_2_75:9.message:
Morty: Ecruteak’s Gym Leader has to
study what are said to be the
legendary Pokémon--Suicune, Entei
and Raikou.

Eusine is here, so I’ve decided to
investigate the Tower with him.

johto_2_75:10.message:
Eusine: I heard that Suicune is in
this Burned Tower, so I came to
look.

But where exactly could it be?

johto_2_76:10.message:
Eusine: I dug a hole here, too…
I was shocked!

Suicune raced by like a blur, right
in front of my eyes!

For ten years I chased Suicune, and
I finally got to see it.

I’m all choked up!

{PLAYER}, I owe this all to you!
Thank you!

I heard that the legendary Pokémon
of Ecruteak test chosen humans by
allowing them to get close.

I’m going to track Suicune.

{PLAYER}, let’s meet again!

Farewell!

johto_2_77:8.message:
Yo, Trainers!
Whether you’re hot to trot,
or cool cat not,
chill at my papa’s spot!

johto_2_77:12.message:
Our sand castle’s taking a long time
to make.

johto_2_77:13.message:
The water around these parts is clean.

But, I get my Zigzagoon to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.

Dirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…

If we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.

johto_2_77:15.message:
Little kids can dart around so quickly…

You don’t dare take your eyes off them
for an instant. It’s very taxing.

Mine are with my Pokémon, so they
should be okay, but…

johto_2_78:1.message:
{PLAYER} tries to move the rock.

Not even Strength would work with
this one.

johto_2_78:4.message:
You travel all over the place,
don’t you?

You’re not driving your Pokémon
too harshly, are you?

Let me take a look.
… … … … … …

johto_2_78:14.message:
A couple of seeds are growing.
Better not touch.

johto_2_78:16.message:
{PLAYER} tries to move the rock.

Not even Strength would work with
this one.

johto_2_79:4.message:
Wahahaha! Today’s technology is a
wondrous thing!

Take this volcanic ash here.
It can be fashioned into glass.

johto_2_79:11.message:
It’s fun walking through the volcano’s
ashes on the ground and grass.

You can see where you walked--it’s
really neat!

johto_2_8:1.message:
Hello…

It, too, was perfection…

johto_2_80:2.message:
I watered the plants every day.
They grew lots of flowers.

And they gave me lots of Berries, too.

Here you go!
You can have it!

johto_2_80:4.message:
What’s that?
What am I doing?

I’m thinking about making my own room
here using a Pokémon move.

I know! I’ll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?

johto_2_80:21.message:
If you don’t raise your Pokémon some
more, it could be tough to keep winning
up through the ranks.

I’ve heard the Pokémon League’s
Elite Four are far stronger than
any Gym Leader.

johto_2_80:24.message:
Oh, no!

My uncle in Mauville told me to take
Rock Smash with me if I was going to
Route 111!

My uncle? He lives across from
the bike shop in Mauville.

johto_2_80:25.message:
I challenged the Winstrate family,
but four matches in a row is tough
going… They destroyed me.

johto_2_81:1.message:
Wouldn’t it be great to ride a Bike
at full speed on Cycling Road?

johto_2_81:2.message:
The two roads, one above, one below…

A road each for people and Pokémon.
Perhaps that is right and fair.

johto_2_81:8.message:
How do you like the way my raven-
colored hair streams behind me?

I grew my hair out just for that.

johto_2_81:15.message:
Oh, hey, you got that Bike from Rydel!

Oh, it’s glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…

Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,
Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,

Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,
Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,

Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,
Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel, Rydel,

…
That name’s everywhere.

You should ride it around all over
the place--it’s good advertising!

johto_2_81:18.message:
I don’t have a Bike, so I’ll take
a leisurely walk on the low road.

johto_2_81:22.message:
Regardless of the results, I count on
seeing more challenges from you.
Always aim higher!

johto_2_81:23.message:
Which should I choose?

Make a beeline for Mauville on
Cycling Road, or take the low road
and look for Pokémon?

johto_2_81:24.message:
Learning techniques will make Bike
riding even more fun.

There are some places that you can
reach only by using a Bike technique.

But if you don’t have the right Gym

johto_34_6:2.message:
I’m looking for the Pokémon
{STR_VAR_1}!

Wanna trade one for my
{STR_VAR_2}?

johto_34_60:1.message:
Before the Magnet Train Station was
built, there was a house there.

A little girl named Copycat used
to live there.

johto_34_60:2.message:
The Magnet Train is a super-modern
rail liner that uses electricity
and magnets to attain incredible
speed.

However, without electricity…

johto_34_60:3.message:
Do you have a Rail Pass? I do!
All the people who ride the Magnet
Train have Passes…

johto_34_60:4.message:
I’m sorry, but the Magnet Train isn’t
operating now.

johto_34_60:6.message:
The Cable Car hasn’t come in…

I know! I’ll carry the passengers on
my back!

That won’t work.

johto_34_61:2.message:
A Pokémon Center near a cave?
That’s mighty convenient.

johto_34_61:3.message:
When you go outside, you can see
the roof of a big building.

That’s the Power Plant.

johto_34_61:4.message:
The Power Plant’s Manager is looking
for a strong Pokémon trainer.

He needs help getting back
something that was stolen.

johto_34_61:5.message:
Welcome to our Pokémon Center!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?

johto_34_61:6.message:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

It’s me, Teala, the Pokémon
Center 2F attendant.

Is there something you needed to
ask me about linking?

johto_34_61:7.message:
Welcome to our Pokémon Center!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?

johto_34_61:9.message:
Do you know about Apricorns?

Crack one open, hollow it out and
fit it with a special device.

Then you can catch Pokémon with it.

Before PokéBalls were invented,
everyone used Apricorns.

johto_34_61:10.message:
Bill’s PC can store up to 30
Pokémon per Box.

johto_34_61:11.message:
Do your Pokémon know HM moves?

Those moves can be used even if
your Pokémon has fainted.

johto_34_62:8.message:
Lava Cookies are Mt. Chimney’s local
specialty.

Try one. It’s just ¥200.

johto_34_63:2.message:
The Pokémon that lived with me…

I loved them like my grandchildren…

johto_34_63:3.message:
There are other graves of Pokémon
here, I think.

There are many chambers that only
Mr.Fuji may enter.

johto_34_63:4.message:
I came with my Mom to visit Pokémon
graves…

johto_34_63:5.message:
Mr.Fuji: Welcome.

Hmm… You appear to be raising
your Pokémon in a kind and loving
manner.

Pokémon lovers come here to pay
their respects to departed Pokémon.

Please offer condolences for the
souls of the departed Pokémon.
I’m sure that will make them happy.

johto_34_64:6.message:
Many people are hard at work here
in the Radio Tower.

They must be doing their best to put
on good shows.

johto_34_64:7.message:
Oh, no, no, no!

We’ve been off the air ever since
the Power Plant shut down.

All my efforts to start this station
would be wasted if I can’t broadcast.

I’ll be ruined!

johto_34_64:8.message:
Hey there, fellow!

I am the super Music Director!

Huh? Your Radio-Visio can’t tune
into my music channels.
How unfortunate!

If you get an Expn Card upgrade,
you can tune in. You’d better get
one!

johto_34_64:9.message:
Welcome!
Feel free to look around anywhere
on this floor.

johto_34_64:10.message:
Sorry, but you can only tour the
ground floor.

Ever since Johto’s Radio Tower was
taken over by a criminal gang, we
have had to step up our security.

johto_34_65:3.message:
My dear Pokémon keep me company,
so I don’t ever feel lonely.

Meowth even brings money home.

johto_34_65:5.message:
Hey, those Running Shoes!
They’re one of our products!

It makes me happy when I see someone
using something we made.

johto_34_65:6.message:
Hello and welcome to the Devon
Corporation.

We’re proud producers of items and
medicine that enhance your life.

johto_34_65:7.message:
I’m trying to develop a device that
visually reproduces the dreams of
Pokémon…

But it’s not going well.

johto_34_65:8.message:
I’m trying to develop a new feature
for the EV-IV Watch…

But it’s not going well.

johto_34_65:9.message:
We’re developing a device for talking
with Pokémon.

But we haven’t had much success…

johto_34_65:10.message:
I made the EV-IV Screen!

As an engineer, I feel blessed to have
made something so great!

johto_34_65:11.message:
If you visit the Shipyard in Slateport,
you should go see Capt. Stern.

johto_34_65:12.message: Mr. Stone: I’m counting on you!

johto_34_66:1.message:
Meh… What do you want?

Who am I?

My name is Alex, and I somehow
you managed to play my game.
Weird, ah?

johto_34_66:2.message:
Mossdeep has mainly sunny weather,
and its winds are stable.

It’s an ideal location for launching
rockets.

johto_34_66:3.message:
I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket launched safely!
That’s successful launch no. 1!

johto_34_66:4.message:
Some people claim that Pokémon came
from space. Could it be true?

johto_34_66:5.message:
Mossdeep has mainly sunny weather,
and its winds are stable.

It’s an ideal location for launching
rockets.

johto_34_66:6.message:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% error margin is allowed.

Even if it’s 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be bad.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It’s a dream that never ends.

johto_34_66:8.message:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% error margin is allowed.

Even if it’s 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be bad.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It’s a dream that never ends.

johto_34_67:1.message:
Aren’t the Twins adorable?

Jasmine’s pretty too.

Oh, I love them!

johto_34_67:2.message:
I’m the Graphic Artist.

I drew you!

johto_34_67:3.message:
Who, me? I’m the Programmer.

Use the Mega Evolution!

johto_34_67:4.message:
Is that right?

I’m the game designer!

Filling up your Pokédex is tough,
but don’t quit!

When you finish, come tell me!

johto_34_67:5.message:
On the 2nd floor of the Institute,
we study the weather patterns over
the Hoenn region.

We’ve been noticing temporary and
isolated cases of droughts and
heavy rain lately…

johto_34_67:6.message:
I’ve been researching rain for many
years, but it’s ridiculous to think
humans can freely change the weather.

johto_34_67:7.message:
The Professor loves rain.
That’s a fact.

But if it keeps raining, people will be
in trouble. That’s another fact.

And thus, the Professor is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.

johto_34_69:2.message:
From here on, you face the
Elite Four one by one.

If you win, a door opens to the
next Trainer. Good luck!

johto_34_69:22.message:
I thought you go by catching a whole
flock of Bird Pokémonm, and then
hanging on to them somehow.

But it turns out there’s an HM move
called Fly!

I wish I’d known about that a long
time ago…

johto_34_69:24.message:
Hmm!
A Super Rod is really good!

Wouldn’t you agree?

johto_34_69:26.message:
Can your Pokémon use its Secret Power
on a big pile of grass and make a
Secret Base?

johto_34_69:43.message:
Berries grow by soaking up sunlight.

We help the Berries grow by watering
them regularly.

It’s an expression of love, isn’t it?

johto_34_70:1.message:
Hmmmm…

I wonder what should I do for my
next trick?

johto_34_8:1.message:
Don’t be so fast to challenge
Falkner!

Visit Sprout Tower first-it’s the
pride of our city!

johto_34_8:8.message:
Hey! I’m no trainer but I can give
some advice!

Believe me! If you believe, a
championship dream can come true.

You believe?
Then listen.

The Grass-type is weak against the
Flying-type. Keep this in mind.

johto_34_83:1.message:
I’m an Art Dealer.

I am a buyer and seller of fine art,
especially paintings.

I’ve heard that the Museum here has
magnificent works on exhibit…

johto_34_83:2.message:
I came from Kanto.

The Hoenn region is beautiful with
all its water and verdant nature.

Hunh? Wait a second…

Could there be rare Pokémon that
live only in this area?

johto_34_83:3.message:
Have you seen that strange cave in
the cove at the edge of town?

johto_34_83:4.message:
Team Aqua’s been training their
Wailmer in the cove.

We Sailors can’t get our boats out
to sea with them in the way!

johto_34_83:5.message:
We just arrived here on our
honeymoon vacation.

We happened to see a Dragon-type
Pokémon flying way up in the sky.

Do cool Pokémon like that live in
the Hoenn region?

johto_34_83:6.message:
On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as
many rare Pokémon as we can.

So we were delighted to see a rare
Pokémon as soon as we arrived.

I mean, we are totally happy!

johto_34_83:7.message:
I was taking a relaxing snooze at the
seaside inn to the sound of waves…

When someone stole my Pokémon!

Who’s the abductor?
Team Aqua? Is it Team Aqua?

johto_34_83:8.message:
There’s a Pokémon Contest Hall
right in this here town.

That means well-raised Pokémon will
come from all over the country.

My heart swells with excitement!

johto_34_83:9.message:
Do you know about the machine
Berry Blender?

johto_34_83:10.message:
I saw this tall tower somewhere
around Route 131.

Could that possibly be…?

johto_34_83:11.message:
I heard there’s a tower somewhere
out on the sea routes.

It’s called the Sky Pillar, I hear.

johto_34_83:12.message:
Even as we grow old and wrinkled,
the sea remains forever young with
the vivid brilliance of life…

Fwohoho fwohohohoho…

johto_34_83:13.message:
It was sixty years ago that my
husband proposed to me here.
The sea remains as beautiful as ever.

Mufufufu mufufufufufu…

johto_34_83:15.message:
The biggest mysteries of life are
in space. I’d love to ride on a
Pokémon to see them…

johto_34_83:16.message:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?

That had been a natural formation,
but then that Team Aqua lot came
along and made their renovations.

They call themselves
the “nature-loving Team Aqua”!

But what they do and what they say
don’t match at all!

johto_34_83:28.message:
I came from Paldea! My name’s
Nemona.

The people here have such strange
names, like Phoebe, Wallace,
Norman…

Your name’s {PLAYER},
that’s the strangest one yet!

johto_34_83:29.message:
I can’t do this anymore!

It’s utterly hopeless!

I’m a Fighting-type Trainer,
so I can’t win at the Mossdeep Gym
no matter how hard I try!

Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!

What, don’t look at me that way!
I’m only hitting the ground!

johto_34_83:30.message:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…

Speaking of the waves, you know that
island city Sootopolis?

I think the Gym there had a new
Leader come in.

People tell me the new Leader once
mentored Wallace.

johto_34_83:31.message:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.

Life, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.

And the sea is always connected to
the land.

Yes, like the very shoreline here.

johto_34_83:32.message:
I’m here to help work on the new
business partnership between
Lilycove, Olivine, and Vermillion.

I finally get to put
my business degree to good use!

Now, where in this city can
I find a hotel…?

johto_34_83:33.message:
Around Mossdeep, you can see wild
Wailmer.

It’s called, uh…
What was it now…

Wai, Wai, Wai…

Wailmer watching!

johto_34_83:34.message:
The island’s Space Center has been
launching huge rockets.

There’s been some kind of an uproar
over a letter they received recently.

johto_34_83:35.message:
I’m a Sailor, so the sea’s obviously
more important to me.

But, when I get back on land after
a long voyage, I do feel relief!

johto_34_83:36.message:
Hey! That’s my hometown badge
you’re wearing! Tell Brock that
Solidad says ’Hey’ when you see
him again, ok?

johto_34_83:41.message:
Wouldn’t it be nice?

If the whole world was covered in
plants and flowers like this island?

johto_34_83:42.message:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the Space Center.

They put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.

When you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?

I use a wish tag to make it happen.
That’s what I do.

johto_34_83:43.message:
A voyage on a ship is fine.

But crossing the sea with Pokémon
using Surf…

Now that’s an exhilarating trip!
Wouldn’t you agree, youngster?

johto_34_83:44.message:
Hey, you!

Don’t go near the cave in the cove!

Why? You don’t need a reason why! I’m
an adult so you just listen to me!

johto_34_84:2.message:
Something’s happening,
and I don’t like it!

I’ve seen shady characters wandering
in and out of Prof. Cozmo’s home…

johto_34_84:8.message:
Exploring a cave isn’t like walking
on a road.

You never know when wild Pokémon will
appear. It’s full of suspense.

johto_34_84:24.message:
I love using the Berry Crush machine,
so I’m collecting Berries.

I’ll share one with you, if you’d like.

johto_34_9:1.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_34_9:5.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_34_9:2.message:
When I was walking in the grass, a
bug Pokémon poisoned my Pokémon!

I just kept going but then my
Pokémon fainted.

You should keep an Antidote with
you.

johto_34_9:3.message:
Do your Pokémon know HM moves?

Those moves can be used even if
your Pokémon has fainted.

johto_34_9:4.message:
They’re fresh out of PokéBalls!

When will they get more of them?

johto_35_0:1.message:
I’m the Day-Care Lady.

We can raise Pokémon for you.

Would you like us to raise one?

johto_35_1:1.message:
Welcome to our Pokémon Center!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?

johto_35_1:2.message:
The Colosseum upstairs at any
Pokémon Center is for link battles.

Battle records are posted on the
wall, so I can’t afford to lose.

johto_35_1:3.message:
I wonder how many kinds of
Pokémon there are in the world.

Three years ago, Prof. Oak said that
there were 150 different kinds.

johto_35_1:4.message:
A higher level Pokémon doesn’t
always win.

After all, it may have a type
disadvantage.

I don’t think there is a single
Pokémon that is the toughest.

johto_35_2:1.message:
Welcome to the Pokémon WIRELESS
Club Union Room.

You may interact directly with
other Trainers here, some of
whom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the ROOM?

johto_35_2:2.message:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

It’s me, Teala, the Pokémon
Center 2F attendant.

Is there something you needed to
ask me about linking?

johto_35_2:3.message:
Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless
Club Direct Corner.

You may interact directly with
your friends here.

Which room would you like to
enter?

johto_35_2:4.message:
Thank you for accessing the
Mystery Gift System.

johto_35_3:1.message:
When I use an item on my Pokémon, it
acts really glad!

johto_35_3:2.message:
I keep losing in battles, and my
Pokémon end up fainting…

Maybe that’s why my Pokémon don’t
like me much…

johto_35_3:3.message:
If you treat your Pokémon nicely,
they will love you in return.

Oh? Let me see your first Pokémon…

johto_35_4:1.message:
…sigh…
I moved here, but I can’t sell my
Bicycles. Why is that?

Could you ride a Bicycle and
advertise for me?

johto_35_4:3.message:
These bikes are cool, but they’re
way expensive!

johto_35_4:5.message:
A plain city bike is good enough
for me.

After all, you can’t put a shopping
basket on a mountain bike.

johto_35_5:1.message:
Oh, you collect Pokémon? My son
Bill is an expert.

He had to leave for the Pokémon
Center in Ecruteak City.

johto_35_5:2.message:
Are you a trainer?

My big brother Bill made the PC
Pokémon storage system.

johto_35_5:3.message:
Bill: Hi, {PLAYER}
Do us a favor and take this
Eevee.

It came over when I was adjusting
the trading system.

Someone has to take care of it,
but I don’t like being outside.

Can I count on you to play with it,
{PLAYER}?

johto_35_5:4.message:
Hello, hello! I’m the official Name
Rater.

I rate the names of Pokémon.

Would you like me to rate names?

johto_35_5:5.message:
When I watered that moving tree
next Route it jumped!

I think it must be a Pokémon.
But it would take someone like
Whitney, our Gym Leader, to beat it.

johto_35_5:6.message:
Lalala lalalala.
Have plenty of water, my lovely!

johto_35_5:7.message:
There’s two Radio Towers.
Here, and in Lavender Town.

johto_35_5:8.message:
A secret to beat Whitney?

Hmm…

I guess Fight and Poison moves would
be useful.

johto_35_5:9.message:
Welcome to Lily’s Berry Shop.

Can I help you with anything?

johto_35_6:1.message:
Sometimes, a healthy Pokémon
may be unable to use its moves.

If that happens, heal it at a
Pokémon Center or use an item.

johto_35_6:2.message:
Once while I was battling, my
Pokémon couldn’t make any moves.

The Power Points, or PP, of its
moves were all gone.

johto_35_7:1.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_35_7:2.message:
If you use Revive, a Pokémon that’s
fainted will wake right up.

johto_35_7:3.message:
My Eevee evolved into an Espeon.

But my friend’s Eevee turned into
an Umbreon.

I wonder why? We both were raising
our Eevee in the same way…

johto_36_0:1.message:
Welcome to our Pokémon Center!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?

johto_36_0:2.message:
Lake Of Rage…

The appearance of a Gyarados swarm…

I smell a conspiracy. I know it!

johto_36_0:3.message:
Morty, the Gym Leader, is soooo
cool.

His Pokémon are really tough too.

johto_36_0:4.message:
The way the Kimono Girls dance is
marvelous. Just like the way they
use their Pokémon.

johto_36_0:5.message:
Pokémon Journal

Special Feature:
Elite Four’s Lorelei!

Known for her logical, calculated,
and cool battling style, Lorelei
has a surprising secret!

johto_36_1:1.message:
Welcome to the Pokémon WIRELESS
Club Union Room.

You may interact directly with
other Trainers here, some of
whom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the ROOM?

johto_36_1:2.message:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

It’s me, Teala, the Pokémon
Center 2F attendant.

Is there something you needed to
ask me about linking?

Welcome to the Pokémon Wireless
Club Direct Corner.

You may interact directly with
your friends here.

Which room would you like to

johto_36_1:4.message:
Thank you for accessing the
Mystery Gift System.

johto_36_2:2.message:
Olivine is on the sea!

And if it’s on the sea, there are
bound to be fish!

I’ve fished here for 30 years.

johto_36_3:1.message:
Ah. You’re on an adventure with
your Pokémon?

Well, what’s an adventure without
treasure hunting?

Am I right, or am I right?

johto_36_3:3.message:
As far as I know, you won’t be
able to Surf and go across the
sea unless you get five Badges.

johto_36_4:1.message:
This happened when I was young.

The sky suddenly turned black. A
giant flying Pokémon was blocking
out the sun.

I wonder what that Pokémon was?

It was like a bird and a dragon.

johto_36_4:2.message:
Is there really a Pokémon that big?

If it exists, it must be powerful.

johto_36_4:3.message:
I’m positive. There’s a new cave
left side on Route 40.

johto_37_0:1.message:
Welcome to our Pokémon Center!

Would you like me to heal your
Pokémon back to perfect health?

johto_37_0:2.message:
Sailors are really generous.

One taught my Pokémon Strength.
Now it can move big boulders.

johto_37_0:3.message:
There’s a guy in Cianwood, across
the sea. I heard him braggin about
his Pokémon.

johto_37_0:4.message:
Wow! You and your Pokémon are
really close!

johto_37_1:1.message:
Welcome to the Pokémon WIRELESS
Club Union Room.

You may interact directly with
other Trainers here, some of
whom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the ROOM?

Is there something you needed to

johto_37_1:4.message:
Thank you for accessing the

johto_37_2:1.message:
Whenever I get in trouble, Daddy
always scares me.

johto_37_2:2.message:
Along the way to Cianwood, there
are four deserted islands.

Bad kids are taken to the islands as
punishment!

johto_37_2:3.message:
While passing through Dim Deep
Cave near Route 40, I saw a Gym
Leader…

johto_37_3:1.message:
Hi!
Do you have a {STR_VAR_1}?

Want to trade it for my
{STR_VAR_2}?

johto_37_4:1.message:
Hi, there!
May I help you?

johto_37_4:2.message:
Do your Pokémon already know the
move for carrying people on water?

johto_37_4:3.message:
My Butterfree came from my boyfriend
overseas.

It carried some Mail from him.

Want to know what it says?

Let’s see… Nope!
It’s a secret!

johto_38_0:1.message:
It’s fun to blow a glass flute while
my boss is talking.

Huff-huff! Puff-puff!

johto_38_0:3.message:
This area is covered in snow,
huff-puff!

I’m specially gifted, huff-puff.

I make glass out of snow
and make items, huff-puff.

Go collect snow with this, huff-puff.

johto_39_0:1.message:
Selphy: Oh?
Do I know you from somewhere?

Oh, but that doesn’t matter.

I am exquisitely bored.
Please, hear my wish.

johto_39_0:2.message:
Butler: The smile of Lady Selphy
has the brilliance of the sun.

Please, I beg you to bring joy
to Lady Selphy.

johto_3_0:6.message:
…

So this is the famous Elm Pokémon
Lab…

johto_3_0:2.message:
Yo, {PLAYER}!

I hear Prof. Elm discovered some
new Pokémon.

johto_3_1:1.message:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.

I had this weird dream about
a Drowzee eating my dream.

And…
I learned how to eat dreams…

Oogh, this is too spooky!

Let me teach it to a Pokémon so
I can forget about it!

johto_3_1:3.message:
Well, now, I’ve had my coffee, and
that’s what I need to get going!

But I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…

Incidentally, is my old Teachy Tv
helping you?

johto_3_1:4.message:
I go shopping in Pewter City
occasionally.

johto_5_2:6.message:
Individual Values, or IVs works like
a Pokémon’s “Genes”.

They are the traits which are passed
down from one generation to another.

Every stat has an IV ranging from 0
to 31 for each stat (HP, ATK, DEF,
SPA, SPD, and SPE), and at lvl 100,
their IVs are added to the Pokémon’s
stats for their total values.

For example, a lvl 100 Tyranitar with
0 EVs and 0 IVs has 310 HP, but if
it had 31 IVs it would reach 341 HP.

johto_5_2:7.message:
STAB or Same-Type Attack Bonus gives
a damage boost to attacks that
are the same type as the Pokémon
using the move.

This boost increases the damage done
by 50%. It can even become 100%
when a Pokémon has Adaptability as
its natural Ability.

For example, a Fire-type Pokémon
using a Fire-type move will gain
a 50% boost because the attack is
the same element as a Pokémon.

johto_5_2:8.message:
Effort Value Points or EVs are unseen
statistics that can increase your
Pokémon’s stats.

EVs are obtained by fighting other
Pokémon.

Depending on the defeated Pokémon,
different EVs will be obtained.

For example, Sneasel will provide
speed EVs, while Chansey will give
HP EVs. For every 4 EVs obtained in
1 stat, that stat will be increased
by 1 extra point at lvl 100.
